created_prompt: I want to devise a three-year plan with specific actions and milestones to achieve the following two connected goals - 1. grow my online platform and 2. publish a cook book. I currently have 1.2M followers to social media channels where I post cooking videos with quick, healthy recipes. I want to convert these recipes into a cookbook.  The plan needs to be realistic within the limited time and budget I have available. I am currently working 4 days a week. Please specifiy within the plan an option for traditional publishing, and an option for self-publishing my cookbook.
